source_run: hand-chosen for the basin flood-fill loop (src/core/zombihop.py)

notes.acquisition: Mid-range values inside the current HPARAM_SPACE. The 6d MOBO winner's acquisition settings were tuned against the EI-convergence loop and several of them (nat_grad_step 0.232) sit outside the space entirely, so carrying them over would be false provenance rather than a warm start.
notes.flood_ci_z: 2.0 ~= a 95% posterior interval on each side: a point joins the basin when its 95% best case reaches the incumbent's 95% worst case. Below ~1.5 the basin collapses to the incumbent's own line; above ~2.5 it tunnels through shallow valleys and merges neighbouring peaks.
notes.flood_k: 6 = d for the 6d ensemble. Each LineBO line contributes ~24 raw points that pare down to a handful, so k must exceed the per-line node count for the fill to bridge to the next line, but stay well under it in total so a single hop cannot cross a valley.
notes.zoom_volume_fraction: 0.5, per the algorithm spec. Note this is a VOLUME ratio in d dimensions, so it triggers readily while the basin is genuinely local and stops on its own once the basin fills its box.
notes.needle_move_tol: 0.10 = ten composition points of L2 movement between consecutive lines.
notes.needle_ci_tol: 0.15 relative change in the bootstrap CI half-width of the median at the best point.
notes.paring_spatial_halfnoise: 1.0 (not the 0.5 default): this radius (x input_noise = 0.128) now also defines the replicate neighbourhood the median CI is bootstrapped over, and 0.5 catches too few points for a usable CI right after a zoom.
notes.max_lines_per_activation: 30, unchanged. It is now the only budget an activation has.
